blocks.raw: <ExamTip>When the LEA gives you a "what movement came next" or "what was this architect reacting to" question, think in terms of thesis and antithesis. Almost every major architectural movement defines itself partly by what it is *not*.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Callout>Philippine earthquake Baroque is a legitimate architectural innovation, not a deficiency. The massive walls and reinforced buttresses of churches like San Agustin in Manila and the Miag-ao Church in Iloilo are engineering responses to a specific environmental challenge. The LEA rewards this nuanced reading.</Callout>
